recalled_knowledge.item: t-channel propagator dressing of a contact coefficient: c(q) = c0 m_med^2/(m_med^2 + q^2) per mediator; long-range limit c ~ 1/q^2
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: standard QFT / light-mediator direct-detection literature (Fornengo-Panci-Regis 2011; Kaplinghat-Tulin-Yu 2014)

recalled_knowledge.item: q^2 = 2 m_A E_R for elastic nuclear recoil
Intrinsic q-power of each Anand NR operator in the rate: O1, O4, O7 q^0; O8, O12 mixed q^0/q^2; O3, O5, O9, O10, O11, O13, O14 q^2; O6, O15 q^4
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Fitzpatrick et al. 2013 / Anand et al. 2014 response functions
recalled_knowledge.reliability: likely (confirmed numerically by the collapse test: O6/q^2 -> O4 to 1.2 %, O15/q^2 -> O12 to 0.7 %)

recalled_knowledge.item: Photon magnetic-dipole NR reduction c1 = e mu Q/(2 m_chi), c5 = 2 e mu m_N Q/q^2, c4 = e mu g_N/m_N, c6 = -e mu g_N m_N/q^2
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: P012 (Fitzpatrick 2012, Gresham-Zurek 2014, Banks-Fox-Weiner 2010); directdm-consistent per P031

recalled_knowledge.item: A kinetically mixed dark photon couples to the nuclear charge only (proton-only O1); a massive mediator replacing the photon multiplies all dipole coefficients by q^2/(q^2 + m^2)
LZ 2024 low-energy search tolerates ~3-5 signal events in 5.4-55 keV (lone-event criterion N_lo <= 3-5)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: P003/P012/P044 assumption; P016 gives 1.6-2.2 from LZ's own fit

recalled_knowledge.item: Energy resolution sigma(E) = 23 sqrt(E/248) keV for the smeared percentile
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: LZ +-23 keV stat at 248 keV; sqrt(E) scaling of LXe TPC resolution

recalled_knowledge.item: Existence and content of the light-mediator SI DM literature (Fornengo, Panci, Regis PRD 84, 115002 (2011); Kaplinghat, Tulin, Yu PRD 89, 035009 (2014))

failed_or_abandoned: Naive power counting 'O_i x q^-2 collapses onto the contact operator one q^2 lower' was wrong at the rate level for q^2 operators (O9, O10, O11 overshoot to q^-2, N_lo 353-4e4); corrected to |c(q)|^2 counting and the note strings in the script were fixed (numbers unchanged)
A Sigma''-only O4 Hamiltonian (WimPyDD response-keyed syntax) to isolate the longitudinal spin response was not built; the O6/q^2 vs O4 agreement (0.988) made it unnecessary
EXPOSURE_2024 = 4.2 t yr is defined in the script but unused; no 2024 event count is quoted
Masses other than 1 TeV were not scanned (P003's mass scaling of N_lo carries over since the propagator factor is m_chi-independent)
wimpydd_generated_files: none (diff_rate used throughout; WimPyDD's internal response-function cache may have been extended for the new Hamiltonian names P074_*)
